distribution_boundary.description: Owner decision of 19 November 2026. Distributed: the source code in the public OpenMettle repositories and the Helm chart in openmettle-deploy. Not distributed yet: built container images (including the core api, worker and migrate images), re-hosted third-party images, curated forks and model weights. Third-party images are referenced only at their publishers' locations. Long-term direction: distribute everything needed to run OpenMettle, eventually as an Arch Linux distribution with everything preinstalled except components whose licences do not allow redistribution. Each widening of the boundary is a separate owner decision; publishing the core images (V1-36) is the likely next one.

review.notes: Recorded by an agent from the owner's decision comment. It defines distribution scope only; it is not a licence review or legal clearance.

cargo_licence_policy.scope: Cargo packages are build inputs under the 19 Nov 2026 boundary: Cargo fetches them from their registries at build time, and no binary or image containing them is distributed. They become shipped content once the core images are published (V1-36), which needs a separate owner decision. Each crate's licence and notice files must then ship with the images.

obligations: When binaries or images containing these crates are distributed, ship each crate's licence and notice files with them.
notices.justification: Build inputs only under the 19 Nov 2026 boundary: the crates are not redistributed in source or binary form.

review.notes: Proposed by an agent on 19 November 2026 for owner approval. Approval adopts a licence-bookkeeping policy; it is not legal clearance. Records in cargo-reviews.json are generated against this list and block readiness until it is approved.
